about_the_game:
You and your friend, under a blanket of stars, talk about deep things... like sex. What could be deeper than that? You share your most intimate desires. And then, by luck and chance, a shooting star crosses the sky and you both wish to sleep with the girls and fictional characters you like the most. Of course, it's about to happen.

→ If you're attracted to your friend's mother, fantasize about your favorite porn actress, and can't stop thinking about the protagonist of the novel you're reading... this is for you:

👠 Cassandra is your friend's mother. She's like wine or cheese, getting better with age. She seduces effortlessly and dominates without asking permission. With her, you never know if you're in a game... or if you've already lost.

💄 You see Scarlett X every night on your screen before going to sleep. She doesn't portray desire... she directs it. Charismatic, playful, and unfiltered, she plays with boundaries until they disappear.

💚 Sylwen is the protagonist of the book "The Legacy of the Red Moon." She has the power of an ancient curse... and the body of a temptation. When she looks at you up close, it's hard to think of anything else but touching her.

→ If you like your friend's sister, daydream about the heroine of your favorite video game, and can't stop looking at your ethics professor... this is for you.

💋 Aria is your friend's sister. Sweet, bright, and charming... until she lowers her gaze and you realize she's looking exactly where you desire. Everyone wants to take care of her, but the truth is she doesn't need protection. What she wants is between your legs.

⚔️ Nyxara is the heroine of your video game... until you discover a hidden option in the menu: Enter the game. Then, she's no longer just a character. She speaks to you in a soft voice, but leaves you trembling. She doesn't need to touch you to ignite you... just saying your name slowly, as if she already knows what you're here for, is enough.

📖 Tessa doesn't just teach ethics... she teaches you to desire what you shouldn't. Each of her words is precise, but her gaze says things that aren't in the syllabus. She's the reason you can't concentrate in class anymore.

FEATURES

  • Visual Novel++ Format: Each girl has different story arcs that complete her own narrative.

  • No Censorship!: We've removed censorship from the images (we’ll add an option later to censor them as preferred).

  • Gallery: Fill an image album as you progress through the story and revisit the chapters you've completed.

  • Choose the Girl: Decide which girl to pursue as the story unfolds.

  • Flashback: Go back in the story at any time to change a decision or relive a moment.

  • Smooth Navigation: Choose whether text progresses automatically or skip it to reach your favorite part.

  • Immersive Audio: Including music, sound effects, voices, and "other effects." Adjust volume settings independently or mute everything.

PLEASE NOTE

  • All characters depicted and visually represented in this game are over 18 years old, and no real or identifiable minors were used in the production of this game.

  • Help us out! If you think you can improve the narrative in your language, feel free to send us your suggestions via email or message us on our Steam page.

  • We're still working on it: All updates and improvements we develop will be added to the game at no additional cost.
